result:
All 617 existing tests pass, typecheck is clean, and my temporary verification suite confirmed each reported bug is fixed. Summary of the changes made:

- **`src/server/services/search-service.ts`**: removed the illegal "field-scoped search is not included in this plan" rejection; the service now parses `kind:`/`in:`/`project:` tokens itself (reusing the client's parser) only when `advanced_search` is on, falls back to the caller's kinds/projectId when no token is present, and forces issue-only results when the flag is off. `indexComment` now looks up the comment's issue to carry its `projectId` into the index. The `search.reindex_requested` listener now handles all three subject kinds and drops (rather than re-adds) missing/archived subjects.
- **`src/components/domain/search/query-syntax.ts`**: split out `extractSearchTokens` (raw token extraction, no default-kind fallback) so the server can tell "no `kind:` token" apart from "defaulted to issue" while keeping `parseSearchQuery`'s existing client behavior unchanged.
- **`src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts`**: escapes `%`, `_`, and `\` in the query before building the SQL `LIKE` pattern (with an explicit `ESCAPE` clause), so those characters are matched literally instead of acting as SQL wildcards.
